Buying Cabinets From a Manufacturer vs. a Dealer or Big-Box Store

Key takeaways

  • A dealer resells cabinets made by someone else; a manufacturer builds them and sells directly.
  • Buying from the maker removes the reseller markup and puts design, production, and installation under one team.
  • Stock and semi-custom lines come in fixed sizes; true custom cabinets are built to your walls.

Three ways to buy kitchen cabinets

  • Big-box and flat-pack stores: stock cabinets in fixed widths, often assembled and installed by someone else.
  • Showroom dealers: semi-custom or custom lines from a factory you never see; the dealer sells and coordinates.
  • Manufacturers: the company that designs and builds the cabinets sells them to you directly.

What changes for you

  • Price: there is no reseller markup between you and the people building your kitchen.
  • Fit: custom cabinets are sized to your walls and appliances, so there are fewer filler strips and less wasted space.
  • Communication: you talk to the people who design and build, not to a middleman relaying messages to a factory.
  • Responsibility: one team answers for the design, the production, and the installation.
  • Changes: if a material has to be substituted, a manufacturer can show you a sample first instead of swapping it silently.

When a big-box kitchen makes sense

If you need a basic kitchen fast and your room fits standard sizes, stock cabinets can be a reasonable choice. Custom pays off when the room is irregular, when you want specific storage, or when the kitchen should last for many years.

How PalmCraft works

PalmCraft is a manufacturer, not a reseller. Cabinet parts are machined on CNC equipment, shaker doors are built in-house rather than ordered from an outside door program, and finishing happens in our own spray booth in Oldsmar, FL.

Before anything goes into production, measurements are verified on site. The people who install your cabinets are on our own payroll and answer to the same project manager who ran your design. You can visit the shop by appointment and see your cabinets before delivery.
